domain: The Matter of Britain across its incompatible versions and branches — chronicle (Gildas/Nennius/Geoffrey/Wace/Layamon), Welsh (the Mabinogion), French (Chrétien/the Vulgate/Perlesvaus/the Queste), German (Wolfram/Gottfried), and English (Malory/the Mortes/the Gawain romances) — for essays on kingship, the Grail, chivalric decline, eros, and fate.
render_note: Anchors: Malory by Book.chapter; Geoffrey by Bk/ch; the Vulgate by Lacy paragraph [N]. The added witnesses (chronicles, Welsh, Grail romances, Mortes, Gawain romances, Tristan) are cited by work, with the work named in the anchor; located_anchor is '?' (no in-file scheme yet) — the gate validates the TEXT, the work-label is the seeder's.
